summary: The milestone completed 10 experiments in 25 minutes, including 1 compute-bound task. Synthesis reconciliation was the longest listed task. Compute-time GPU efficiency and parallel-model dispatch remain unverified by the supplied evidence.
bottlenecks_identified: The synthesis-only task 'Reconcile thirteen outcomes and decide verification learning and deployment gaps' took 13 minutes in TIMING DATA and is the longest listed task; no phase breakdown identifies the cause or the avoidable portion.

The synthesis-only task 'Inspect only new authenticated supervisor outcomes for transferable arm selectio' took 5 minutes in TIMING DATA and is the next longest listed task; the evidence does not show which inspection steps could be shortened.
Disk-mtime reconstruction provides task durations without execution-phase or dependency receipts, limiting diagnosis of the scheduling critical path.
improvements_suggested: Build an incremental outcome reducer that caches checked evidence and emits an obligation-to-outcome table for reconciliation; measure whether it shortens the longest synthesis task.
Emit a reusable, source-linked summary from authenticated-supervisor inspection so reconciliation can consume the same checked evidence.
Record task start and end events, workload class, dependency waits, and phase durations instead of relying on disk-mtime reconstruction.
Join GPU utilization samples to active compute intervals and record concurrent model loading and runner dispatch, so the snapshot and locked task-idle indicator can be reconciled.
Use DualGPURunner only for confirmed concurrent multi-model workloads; single-model GGUF inference can correctly use a single GPU, and synthesis-only GPU idleness is expected.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Automate the reconciliation evidence table with incremental, source-linked outcome reduction.
Capture task and phase receipts to locate avoidable synthesis work and compute overhead.
Capture compute-interval GPU utilization, concurrent model loading, and runner dispatch to resolve utilization and DualGPURunner questions.
meta_reflection: The sole compute-bound task, 'Freeze an observed request sequence without injected exact repeats', is reported as 3 minutes in TIMING DATA; no loading, inference, or I/O phase measurements explain its duration. The snapshot shows idle GPUs, but the locked task-idle flag is false and the snapshot is not linked to an active compute interval, so execution efficiency remains unresolved. Parallel-model overlap and DualGPURunner dispatch have no data available this milestone; the savings estimate is a conservative placeholder for unmeasured savings.
